hookups.source: https://beaverrunrvpark.com/ ('pull-thru sites with 30 and 50 amp full hook-up service and cable and WI-FI'; 'Sites are 30 or 50 amp, and come with full hook-up, cable, and free WiFi'); park map legend '30/50 Full' on every RV site (https://beaverrunrvpark.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Beaver_Creek_RV_Park_August_2024.jpg), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Level pull-through sites, shaded and open, 'Big Rig Friendly'; the park map numbers about 80 full-hookup sites (lakeside row 54-72), plus tent sites and cabins.

sites.source: https://beaverrunrvpark.com/ ('This Metter campground has level, pull-thru sites that are Big Rig Friendly'); park map (August 2024), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://beaverrunrvpark.com/ (Amenities: 'Clean Bathrooms', 'Hot Showers', 'Coin Laundry', 'Propane Refilling', 'Free Fiber Internet and Cable TV', game room, playground, swimmable spring-fed lake); https://beaverrunrvpark.com/faq/ (fiber internet at every site plus a WiFi network), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Call 912-362-4737 or send the website's reservation request form. A non-refundable deposit of the first night holds a site; holiday weekends are paid in advance, non-refundable.

booking.source: https://beaverrunrvpark.com/reservations/ ('If you have questions or would like to make a reservation, feel free to contact us! Our policy is to take a non-refundable deposit equivalent to your first night's stay'); https://beaverrunrvpark.com/ ('Call today to book'); https://beaverrunrvpark.com/faq/ (cancellation policy), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $45 a night, $50 for a holiday night; $290 a week, $555 a month plus electricity. 3% surcharge on card payments. Rec pass for the lake's boats and boards $10 a stay. Read 2026-10-29.

fees.source: https://beaverrunrvpark.com/camping/ (Rate: Nightly $45, 1 Week $290, Monthly $555 +Electricity, 3 Month - Cash $1565, Holiday $50 for 1 night; 3% card surcharge); https://beaverrunrvpark.com/faq/ (rec pass $10), read 2026-10-29

discounts.source: https://beaverrunrvpark.com/reservations/ ('Want to save 10% on your stay? Join Good Sam Club now!'); https://beaverrunrvpark.com/camping/ ('Ask about our Good Sam Discount!'), read 2026-10-29

note: Just off I-16 at Exit 111. Spring-fed Shine Lake in the middle of the park, with a swim beach and boats; the 54-72 row faces it across the loop road. Hosts snowbirds and working travellers as well as overnighters. No Dobermans, Rottweilers, chows or pit bulls.
summary: Park pages confirm: 30/50 A full hookups, level big-rig pull-throughs, showers/laundry/fiber internet; $45 nightly ($50 holiday), $290 weekly, $555 monthly + electric, 3% card fee; book by phone/form with a 1-night deposit; Good Sam 10% confirmed (military left: page silent). Tent $25 dropped from fees note (not on the site now). Note: dropped rates, booking, site-type and 23-ft text; added the lake row and pet-breed rule. Pin OK.
